Manufacturing • Consulting • Marketing

Unity is a leading platform providing tools and services for creators to build games, apps, and immersive experiences. With high-quality graphics, multi-platform support, and AI enhancements, Unity empowers developers in video gaming and other industries like manufacturing. Unity offers services such as Unity Engine, Unity Cloud, and Unity Grow, which include real-time 3D creation, user acquisition, and game monetization. The company also provides extensive resources, community support, and professional training for creators at all levels. Through its success plans and developer resources, Unity aids in solving complex problems and bringing ideas to life for gaming and enterprise professionals.

📋 Description

• Lead a new team delivering Unity platform support for a key platform partner bringing games to TV and mobile form factors • Deliver stable platform support • Realize developer workflows for Unity users to unlock unique platform features • Lead optimization initiatives to enable Unity to be efficient across a wide array of target devices • Own and drive near-term execution and technical strategy for the team • Collaborate internally with other core Unity engineering and graphics teams • Communicate the team’s vision and progress internally and externally • Foster a high-performance, supportive culture through mentoring and coaching • Actively guide team members’ professional development and career growth

🎯 Requirements

• Experience developing and managing a high-performance software engineering team • Proven technical knowledge in desktop/mobile/web platform technology stacks using platform APIs to build native applications • Demonstrated success collaborating with internal Product owners and external partners to achieve alignment on technical specifications and interdependencies • Expertise as a software engineer • Working familiarity with C++, C# and JavaScript • Ability to assimilate and understand a large and complex software product • Familiarity with real time 3D rendering techniques and graphics APIs including Vulkan and/or WebGPU (optional) • A methodical approach to prioritizing and developing innovative optimization solutions (optional) • A passion for the future of computer games or real-time 3D experiences (optional) • Expertise leading remote teams using Agile development methodologies (optional) • Familiarity with when and how to best use AI in the software development process (optional) • Sufficient knowledge of English for professional verbal and written exchanges

🏖️ Benefits

• Equity awards • Participation in company incentive plans, such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions • Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance • Commute subsidy • Employee stock ownership • Competitive retirement/pension plans • Generous vacation and personal days • Leave and family-care programs for new parents • Office food snacks • Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support • Employee Resource Groups • Global Employee Assistance Program • Training and development programs • Volunteering and donation matching program
